name: autoanimate
title: Auto Animate
description: Animates children of a container as they are added, removed or moved, using the View Transitions API.

classes.name: auto-animate
classes.description: Every direct child gets its own view-transition name (match-element) so it animates during a view transition.

notes: The animation runs during a view transition. For changes made with JavaScript, wrap the DOM update in document.startViewTransition(() => { … }). For full page loads, opt in to cross-document transitions with @view-transition { navigation: auto; }.
Browsers without view transitions or view-transition-name: match-element apply the change without animating.

examples.title: Add and remove items
examples.description: The buttons wrap their DOM changes in document.startViewTransition().
